patterns.note: Full-bleed imagery and video are used extensively, creating immersive, large-scale sections where content often overlays these visuals, establishing a premium and expansive feel.
Headings are large, often thin or light-weighted sans-serifs, providing a sophisticated and airy feel, contrasted with smaller, more conventional body text and occasional uppercase labels.
A striking royal blue is used as a dominant accent and background color, providing a bold and energetic contrast to the otherwise minimalist black, white, and off-white palette.

The site features a full-width video hero on the homepage, and the main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport across all pages. No scroll-triggered reveal animations or parallax effects can be observed from the provided images as they are not a scroll sequence of the same page.

Sections are distinct, full-width blocks, often alternating between high-quality product photography, lifestyle imagery, and abstract graphic backgrounds to maintain visual interest and clear content separation.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion, implement a sticky header that remains fixed at the top of the viewport. The homepage hero section should feature an autoplaying, looping video as its background, with text content overlaid for legibility. No scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects are observed from the provided images.
Full-bleed, high-resolution photography and video are used as section backgrounds, often with subtle dark overlays to ensure text readability and create depth.
Typography relies on a clear hierarchy, using very large, often light-weight sans-serif fonts for headlines to convey a sense of luxury and space, paired with smaller, highly legible body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, often thin or light-weight sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) create an airy, luxurious feel, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels and standard-sized body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle radius (e.g., ~4-8px) on interactive elements like buttons, while most other design elements maintain sharp, angular corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and generous, particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, contributing to a premium and uncluttered aesthetic.

standout: The distinctive and bold use of a deep, vibrant royal blue as a primary brand color, integrated into full-bleed sections and contrasted with minimalist black and white, immediately sets it apart from typical luxury electronics sites. This, combined with the custom, elegant typography, creates a strong, memorable brand identity.
